mark: Each name is a plate with 2 px corners in its colour, the letters in the chrome display with a soft bloom. The round mark is a neon ring with a near-white core and a bloom in the name's colour; the current mark takes a tube ring.
stackbar: The share bar is a held tube track with the stripe's gap between parts; pointing at a part turns it up in one step, with its colour's bloom, and its legend label takes the pink tube. The title is the OSD in capitals after a cyan arrow. The bar rises over its horizon in two beats.
bullets: The figure is the OSD's read-out; a warned or over-threshold row has the hollow neon ring in the tone's ink before the figure and the figure glows in that ink. Rows rise over their horizon one beat apart; pointing at a link row turns the label's tube up.
tick: A laser is drawn under a changed figure from its centre outward in one beat, flares, and burns down in three beats; the figure itself never moves.
uptime: The strip rises over its horizon. A cell you point at turns up with a bloom in its own colour; the title is the OSD after a cyan arrow, the percentage a cyan read-out.
uptime-states: Loading is the busy card with the marquee bulbs chasing one in four; an error summary is a 2 px chip in the red. Every state keeps the strip's height.
uptime-phone: At 390 px the strip and its summary keep one line each and the rise and the bloom behave as at full width.
inbox: A new or next row has a pink-to-cyan bar on its start edge. Pointing at a row turns the title's tube up; a failed or warned row has the neon ring in front of its title with the title glowing in the tone's ink. Rows rise over their horizon one beat apart; meta lines are the OSD.
backlog: The same rows with the payload in a 2 px slot in the mono; the dead message has the red ring before its id.
files: The file type is an OSD tag, a missing file has the red ring, and View and open-in-tab are synthwave's own tube buttons.
appointments: The next appointment takes the pink-to-cyan bar and a lit pink lead with its tube; past rows go quiet by ink. Times are OSD read-outs.
checks: A warning check carries the hollow amber neon ring before its title with the fix written under it behind a hairline; failed is the same in red. No filled plate.
sort: The sort a page carries out is drawn in synthwave's own table header, unchanged from the approved table: a column that cannot be sorted now is quiet and gives no pointer.
kv: Keys are OSD capitals in pink after a cyan arrow; a changed row carries a pink tube mark; a row that could not be read has its key glowing red with the ring before it.
formrows: Labels are OSD capitals in pink with plain small print under them, controls keep synthwave's 2 px frames, a failed row's label glows red with the ring before it.
tiles: Choices are tape plates with the stripe along their top. Pointing at one turns the tube up (a pink bloom and a glowing title), checked it is lit pink with a bloom, a press drops the bloom.
card-states: Loading is the busy card with the marquee; empty and failed fill the same footprint (failed has a normal Retry); ready rises over its horizon in two beats.
header: The page header keeps its title and badge; the freshness line beside it is a cyan OSD read-out.
art: Synthwave's set is the floor under its existing sun: the marquee's bulbs unlit for none, a neon ring over a laid laser for nothing found, a red neon ring with its bar for an error, the horizon tube cut in two for offline, every bulb lit for done, and a shutter with a lock for locked. Each drawing rises over its horizon in two beats.
pipeline: Lanes are the tape, square, with the pink-to-cyan stripe along their top; the head is the OSD after a cyan arrow with the count in the display face. A card turns its tube up when pointed at, the chosen card keeps a near-white edge and a pink bloom.
pipeline-states: Loading is the busy card with the marquee over lanes that keep their place; empty and failed fill the board with a normal Retry; lanes rise one beat apart.
journey: The horizon runs between the steps reached as a pink-to-cyan line with a faint bloom, steps to come are the road's dashes, and the current step is the striped sun. Titles are OSD capitals, dates cyan.
journey-states: Loading is the marquee over the path, no dates yet keeps the dashes, and the phone width turns the path to a column.
contact: Moments sit on the run timeline's lanes; pointing at one gives it a pink bloom, zones are bands with a hairline start edge, the +1 count is a 2 px OSD chip.
contact-states: Loading is the busy card with the marquee, empty and failed keep the height with a normal Retry.
secret: The value is a dark tube slot in the mono; shown, its edge goes pink with a bloom and the text strikes on like a tube with its two dips. The countdown is a near-white laser burning down; a failure glows red.
secret-phone: The same field stacked for 390 px; the laser keeps the full width.
manage: The wide dialog rises over its horizon. Section headings are OSD capitals after a cyan arrow, sections are divided by a horizon line fading at both ends, and the danger section's heading has the red neon ring and glows red.
confirm: The dependents list is a square slot; a blocked removal shows no field.
type-dialog: The name to type is a cyan OSD chip; what is lost is a slot with a red line along its top and a red OSD heading; a match gives the input a cyan bloom.
type-own: In the page's own dialog every state keeps one height; the match line is an OSD read-out that never moves the buttons.
type-phone: At 390 px the dialog keeps its order and the match line stays one line.
disc: The sun sets: the share left is the striped sun, a pink-to-orange disc whose stripes thicken toward its foot, turning back to twelve o'clock as time goes, on a face ringed in cyan with a near-white hub.
disc-states: Paused dims the sun; ended rings the face in red with a red glow and a red status word. Every state keeps the face's size.
disc-phone: At 390 px the disc is capped to the window; caption and buttons centre under it.
countdown: The digits are the chrome display with the pink tube in fixed cells; the name is an OSD label in pink, the status an OSD line.
countdown-states: Paused puts the tube out; ended makes the name and digits glow red and rings the plate in red.
range: Presets are synthwave's segmented control; the custom panel opens under its button on the tape plate; bound labels are pink OSD capitals.
range-states: A custom window, a limit, disabled and phone width; an invalid bound gives a red glowing OSD message and nothing else turns red.
wheel: The arcade wheel: marquee bulbs run round the rim, the pointer is a pink triangle with a bloom, and the turn glides on the sunrise curve. The winning name is lit with the pink tube; labels are the OSD.
cook: One step at a time: the step rises over its horizon when you move to it, the ingredients stand under a pink rule, the counter and amounts are OSD. Loading, failed and empty keep the height.
timers: Each timer is the tape with its stripe and the time in the display face with the pink tube (out when paused). An ended timer has its name and state glowing red.
quantity: Minus and plus are synthwave's tube buttons around a 2 px slot; the figure is the OSD at a larger size and the unit is cyan.
checklist: A row turns its tube up when pointed at, a ticked item sinks, the head is the OSD after a cyan arrow; rows rise in two beats.
tri: A chip that must be in is lit pink with a bloom and a tube on its word; one that must not be in has a red edge and a struck word; the summary is a cyan OSD line.
code: The code block is the tape with the stripe along its top; the title is the OSD after a cyan arrow over a hairline.
command: The terminal name is an OSD label after a cyan arrow over the tape's stripe; the prompt is cyan; the code rises over its horizon in two beats when the page draws it.
command-long: Long commands wrap or scroll inside the same tape; continued lines keep their gap and never run under Copy.
command-phone: At 390 px the head stays on one line and Copy keeps its width.
compare: The divider is a near-white tube with a pink bloom, like a horizon; the grip is a 2 px control, the labels are OSD capitals after a cyan arrow.
compare-live: Loading lays the busy card with the marquee over the images; a failed image shows its words and a normal Retry.
